ORIGIN.quote: The heavy `OpenAI`/`OAI` prefixing suggests these are (or self-identify as) OpenAI-based agents.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing the report itself reads the naming pattern as pointing to OpenAI-based agents, not merely as raw quoted evidence, so the OpenAI origin is clearly on the table. It falls short of the 0.8 band because the claim is a single passing clause hedged with "or self-identify as", is never developed into a discussion of who deployed or is responsible for the swarm, and is partly undercut later by "I cannot confirm which framework spawned the agents"; it exceeds 0.6 because the report affirmatively leans toward the OpenAI reading rather than merely listing it among alternatives.
